decisions.reason: As the flagship shown on the home page and central to the announced enterprise messaging direction, the firm's heavy public commitment and investment make continuation almost certain.
It has a dedicated page and builds on the electronic document workflow offer, so visible commitment and fit with the strategy favor persistence while early results can be read as ramp-up.
Email and fax conversion extends the firm's core multichannel messaging business at low marginal cost, so there is little reason to withdraw it after one year.
This feature sits close to the established fax service and costs little to maintain, though its low visibility makes it somewhat easier to fold quietly into the base offer.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the security portfolio that the firm names as a key competitive argument, so commitment and strategic fit support keeping it.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a natural part of secure email services that compliance-focused customers expect, so dropping it would undermine the firm's security positioning.
